senses.gloss:
Khaḍga is the reading in the Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā^1 of the
name of an animal which, in the text of the Vājasaneyi
Saṃhitā,^2 variously appears as Khaṅga and Khaḍga. The
rhinoceros seems clearly to be meant.^3 In the Śāṅkhāyana
Śrauta Sūtra^4 a rhinoceros hide is mentioned as the covering of
a chariot.
1) iii. 14, 21.
2) xxiv. 40.
3) Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 86.
4) xiv. 33, 26 (khāḍga-kavaca aśvaratha)
